title: Sources: Masayoshi Son recently explored a possible $1T buyout of SK Hynix; SoftBank says the deal is "no longer under active consideration" (The Information)
summary: The Information: Sources: Masayoshi Son recently explored a possible $1T buyout of SK Hynix; SoftBank says the deal is “no longer under active consideration” — SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son recently approached Wall Street institutions about financing a possible trillion-dollar buyout of memory chip giant SK Hynix …
